messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@pathfinder.health>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Lewis <ben.lewis@pathfinder.health>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP & Close-to-live cadence for Pathfinder - SOW attached

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the SOW. Pathfinder is ready to move fast; our board sign-off completed yesterday and we want to align on a tight MAP so we can hit a June 15 go-live target for a phased rollout. Key asks from our side: 

- Confirm a 2-week canary window in production (target June 1–14) with rollback criteria.
- A three-cohort training plan: admin, power-users, and end-users, staggered across two weeks.
- Clear evaluation plan (prompt set + acceptance criteria) for the first-week production samples.
- Procurement/PO details — procurement@pathfinder.health will lead.

Attached: SOW_Pathfinder_Draft.pdf (we noted a couple of line items to discuss on pricing). Please propose the MAP with milestones and owner assignments and we’ll turn the PO around quickly.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product
Pathfinder Health


From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@pathfinder.health>
Cc: Ben Lewis <ben.lewis@pathfinder.health>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP & Close-to-live cadence for Pathfinder - SOW attached

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the quick signal — congratulations on board sign-off. We’ve sketched a mutual action plan that embeds the full post-signature implementation timeline (rollout, canary, migration, training) and an evaluation plan for production acceptance. Please see the attached MAP_Pathfinder_v1.xlsx and Evaluation_Prompts_v2.csv. High-level proposed cadence: 

- Week of May 10: Provisioning & environment access (private staging + production namespaces) — owner: Karthik
- Week of May 17: Integration + migration dry-run (data subset) — owner: Marissa
- Week of May 24: Training cohort 1 (admins) & dry-run canary in staging — owner: Marissa
- June 1–14: Production canary (10% traffic, rolling ramp) with daily health gates; acceptance criteria defined in Evaluation_Prompts_v2.csv — owner: Karthik + Redwood SREs
- June 15: Target go-live (gradual ramp to 100% over 3 days) — owners: Pathfinder + Redwood ops

Rollbacks: immediate fallback to model-variant v1 with degraded latency preserved; automatic traffic divert if error-rate > 2.5% sustained for 5 min or if quality regression measured against prompt set exceeds thresholds. We’ll include runbooks for both rollback and short-term mitigation (cache warmup, batching throttle).

Open items for you to confirm: 
1) PO timing and any billing milestones (we can align invoice milestone to canary completion).
2) Which admin users should be in cohort 1 (we’ll need a list of 6–8 people to seed training).
3) Any regulatory review windows (privacy/compliance) that would block provisioning in the May 10 window.

Next steps: I’ll circulate an internal kickoff agenda and a per-owner checklist. If that looks good I’ll lock the MAP and send a mutual acceptance email to get PO routed.

Attachments: MAP_Pathfinder_v1.xlsx, Evaluation_Prompts_v2.csv

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@pathfinder.health>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal - MAP owners & readiness checklist (Pathfinder)

Team —

Looping you in on the MAP we just proposed to Pathfinder. This message is an internal checklist + asks to make the MAP executable. Please don't reply-all with any draft pricing notes; keep commercial redlines to me.

Top-level owners & asks: 
- Karthik (Infra & Canary): Provision prod namespace by May 10, validate KV cache warmup, confirm model-variant compatibility for graceful fallback. Provide an infra smoke-test script by May 12.
- Marissa (Onboarding & Migration): Lead the dry-run migration (sample CDC export) on week of May 17. Build the training curriculum for cohort 1 (admins) and schedule two 90-minute sessions week of May 24.
- Priyom (Canary Eval & Metrics): Wire the evaluation prompts into our telemetry so we can measure quality regression and collect tokens/samples; define the measurement query (precision/recall surrogate) by May 14.

Acceptance gates (to be captured in MAP spreadsheet): 
- Provisioning validated in staging with 3 successful inference runs on a 10k token sample.
- Migration dry-run completes with no data loss and <1% request mismatch.
- Canary health thresholds met for 72 hours before ramping beyond 10% traffic.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: Production spikes in token qps — Mitigation: pre-warm pools and temporary burst capacity (ops runbook).
- Risk: Model quality drift vs. expected prompts — Mitigation: immediate rollback to variant + manual review window.

Deliverables I will share to Pathfinder once we lock the MAP: finalized MAP spreadsheet, runbooks (rollback + mitigation), training schedule invite, and evaluation report template.

Please reply with confirmations or blockers by EOD May 4 so we can keep the May 10 provisioning target.

Thanks —
Vanessa
